environment.description: Service deployed on EC2 instance in private subnet, accessed via internal NLB (TCP passthrough, layer 4 only). Service mesh uses mTLS for transport encryption between services. API tokens are issued to internal microservices via Vault. The NLB performs no request inspection — it forwards raw TCP to the Flask application on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR.

config.network: private subnet, SG allows 10.0.0.0/8 on port 8080
config.service_mesh: Istio mTLS STRICT mode for transport
config.secrets: Vault-issued HMAC tokens for service auth
